articles.body:
Check out the Carrie Season Two announcement video as the horror series from showrunner Mike Flanagan gets renewed for a second season. Carrie stars Summer H. Howell as Carrie White and Samantha Sloyan as Margaret White.

The series sees Mike Flanagan again at the helm as showrunner and executive producer, alongside returning executive producer Stephen King, as they bring the next chapter of the story to life in Season Two.

From visionary showrunner Mike Flanagan, the urgent and unexpected reimagining of Stephen King’s seminal story brings new depth and complexity to its iconic characters, exploring the forces that shape Carrie White (Summer H. Howell) as she navigates the cruelty and pressures of the modern world. But Carrie’s story doesn’t stop at Prom – it’s far from over…much remains in store from Mike Flanagan and Stephen King, as new revelations will come to light, major character arcs, and plenty of shocking twists.

All eight episodes of Season One of Carrie are available now on Prime Video.

articles.title: Seth Rogen and Brad Bird Lead 2026 Infinity Festival Lineup
articles.summary: Seth Rogen, Brad Bird, and Travis Knight will showcase upcoming animated projects like Tangles and Wildwood at L.A.’s Infinity Festival this November.
articles.body:
Seth Rogen, Brad Bird, and more are headed to next month’s Infinity Festival in Los Angeles. The event, which explores “the intersection of Hollywood, Silicon Valley and emerging technologies through programming spanning film, television, gaming, animation, music, and more” is slated to showcase how technology is transforming storytelling.

This year's lineup features the team behind the animated film Tangles, including Rogen, who’s producing and voice acting in the movie, along with producer Lauren Miller Rogen, director, producer, and co-screenwriter Leah Nelson, and co-writer Sarah Leavitt. A special screening of Tangles will also be shown at the festival.

Additionally, The Incredibles and Ratatouille filmmaker Brad Bird will be honored with Infinity Festival's Lifetime Achievement Award for his contributions to animation and filmmaking. Bird is directing the upcoming Netflix/Skydance animated feature Ray Gunn, which will receive a special screening at Infinity Festival.

Finally, Travis Knight, President and CEO of LAIKA and director of the studio's upcoming stop-motion animated feature Wildwood will be presented with Infinity Festival's Monolith Award for Visionary Storytelling, recognizing “his innovative approach to animation and filmmaking.” As part of the Infinity Festival, Knight will offer an “inside look at the creative process behind Wildwood, including the groundbreaking technologies developed specifically to bring the film to life.” The Infinity Festival is slated to take place November 12-15 in Los Angeles. For more information about the Infinity Festival, check out .

articles.title: GTA 6 Is Almost Here: Trade in Your Old Console and Save on an Upgrade at PayMore
articles.summary: What is your old system worth?
articles.body:
We are finally under a month away from one of the most anticipated pop culture events ever: the release of Grand Theft Auto 6. It's been over 13 years since GTA 5 was released, and a new entry is finally almost here. Similar to many of Rockstar's games, GTA 6 looks to push graphical fidelity in many ways. So, if you're excited for GTA 6 (who isn't?) you'll need one of the latest consoles. If you're still playing on PS4 or Xbox One, you will not be able to play, as the game will only launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

However, there's still time to pick up a new console, and trading in your old gaming system is a great way to make that transition more affordable. As you look for console trade-in benefits everywhere, PayMore is a great option.

Earn $10 Store Credit When You Trade-In Your Used Console at PayMore

Right now, electronics resale franchise, PayMore is offering a new Level Up program that gives you a $10 PayMore promotional credit in addition to your regular cash offer. This can be put toward a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X, meaning you'll have everything you need to play GTA 6 . This offer lasts through November 20 at participating locations. You'll just need to check if there's a store near you first:

Current-generation consoles likely aren't going anywhere for a long while due to the component shortage, so purchasing one today is not something you'll likely regret. With demand for essential components continuing to climb, too, there's no telling if current prices will hold.

If you haven't heard of PayMore until now, it's a top-rated electronics buyer with stores across the U.S., specializing in purchasing your old smartphones, tablets, laptops, and of course, consoles.

Simply put, if you're looking to sell electronics, you can bring them to a PayMore store and get a free evaluation using real-time market pricing software, and walk out with cash. The store aims to keep the process transparent and fair, taking into account the condition, age, and market demand. It seems worth checking out as you explore your console trade-in options right now.

GTA 6 is set to finally return to Vice City for the first time in a mainline GTA game since 2002, with dual protagonists Jason and Lucia caught up in a conspiracy that takes them across the city. We've already seen so many new features revealed , and there's sure to be dozens more discoveries once the game is out next month.

Noah Hunter is a freelance writer and reviewer covering games and technology. When he's not writing for IGN, he runs Final Weapon, a site focused on Japanese games and anime. His favorite series include Xeno, Fate, Final Fantasy, and far too many RPGs to list.

articles.title: Valve Developer Mistakenly Mentions Rumored Half-Life 3 Codename
articles.summary: A Valve developer mistakenly slipped up and made mention of Half-Life 3's long rumored codename during a recent conference.
articles.body:
A Valve developer mistakenly slipped up and made mention of Half-Life 3's long-rumored codename during a recent conference.

For years, fans have wondered if we'll ever see Half-Life 3. During the 2010s, hope for the threequel was kept firmly alive by die-hard fans... but it was later revealed that the project had been quietly killed by Valve. However, hope was reignited when Valve released Half-Life: Alyx, which ended with a massive cliffhanger that seemed to directly set up Gordon Freeman's next adventure. Ever since then, there have been rumors of a third game, with various dataminers discovering references to a project known as "HLX" in various Valve-related files. It has been believed for years that HLX is indeed Half-Life 3, as no one has been able to link it to any other existing Valve project. (And, of course, the acronym all but screaming that it's Half-Life related.)

Now, Valve has acknowleged the project itself, though not on purpose. During a recent Q&A panel at GameSoundCon, a conference for video game audio, Valve's music designer, Mike Morasky, was explaining how the developer handled certain sound systems and noted that Deadlock uses a particular type of high dynamic range audio... and HLX uses its own kind of HDR.

We have the first mention of HLX by a Valve employee. HLX files today. I'm working as quickly as I can. — Tyler "Hype Merchant" McVicker (@Tyler_McV) October 22, 2026

We have the first mention of HLX by a Valve employee. HLX files today. I'm working as quickly as I can.

Once the words HLX came out of Morasky's mouth, he pretty much stopped talking. Whether that's because he had finished his thought or if he realized he should stop talking is up in the air. A colleague sitting next to Morasky then quietly said "nice work," which some fans have read into as a passive-agressive retort to Morasky's slip up. Fans went buckwild with this small, but notable mistake. Some ran with it, feeling like all of their theories and copium has been vindicated after this mention.

Regardless, this does seem to confirm that HLX is a project that is still actively in development at Valve. We can only hope that it is the long-rumored Half-Life 3, but who knows how far away it could be from being announced, let alone released. Half-Life: Alyx had an exceptionally fast turn around time for being announced and released, so it's possible that a similar pattern would emerge here. If that's the case, maybe we can hope to see it at The Game Awards, but that's still probably a longshot.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: Saber Interactive CEO Says Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival is Performing 'Extremely Well on PC and Consoles' with More to Come
articles.summary: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival has been a smash hit, says Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch in a post on LinkedIn, and it’s the first of a "series" of releases from the studio that will improve its methodology.
articles.body:
Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival has been a smash hit, says Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch in a post on LinkedIn, and it’s the first of a “series” of releases from the studio that will improve how it makes games in the future.

Hellraiser: Revival has proven to be a smashing success, in spite of — or, perhaps because of — its super-spicy content. The game doesn’t skirt around the sex, blood, and gore that defined the source material, causing some content creators to get permanently banned despite taking pains to censor their playthroughs.

In an October 19 LinkedIn post, Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch praised the Hellraiser development team, revealing the title has been performing “extremely well on PC and console” since its October 8 release.

He also speculated that AAA titles with massive budgets and lengthy development timelines won’t be sustainable in the industry for much longer (if, indeed, they are right now), instead positing that AA games based on established IPs with smaller budgets are likely a more realistic path forward.

“The game is testament to the notion that an established IP and solid AA development with controlled costs can produce great results and high user scores,” he wrote. “I believe a greater focus on these middle-market IP-driven products, rather than AAA behemoths, is the future to maintaining growth and momentum in the game industry.

“While I believe there will always be a place for the properly-developed and budgeted AAA experience, a AA game that provides a great immersive experience for a lower price is less risky and can provide much greater returns on average.”

Karch went on to say that Hellraiser: Revival is “the first in a series of releases by Saber that will continue to prove out our methodology,” teasing that there’s “more to come in just a few short weeks.”

While IGN scored the game a six out of ten , Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival boasts a “very positive” player score on Steam , and has earned no small amount of praise from content creators who showed up in droves to broadcast the game on release.

Of course, given its content, it’s no surprise that some streamers got the ban hammer — but, according to its developers, that’s exactly what they were aiming for when they made it.

"It was an unofficial goal of the team to be banned, unrated, or restricted at least somewhere in the world as one barometer of whether we’d done our jobs right,” narrative director Antony De Fault told IGN in an exclusive interview .

Even Clive Barker himself was impressed , saying he was “fearful at one point that the game would be overly censored but I’m genuinely astonished by how far they’ve been able to push it.”

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.title: Alienware's Outstanding 32" 4K 240Hz Quantum-Dot OLED Gaming Monitor Drops to an All-Time Low
articles.summary: If you're looking for the best 4K gaming monitor, this should definitely be on your short list.
articles.body:
One of Alienware's highest-end gaming monitors is down to the lowest price this year. Ahead of Black Friday, Dell has lowered the price of the 32" Alienware AW3225QF 4K QD OLED gaming monitor to $779.99 with free shipping. The AW3225QF is a rare gaming monitor that combines a native 4K resolution and 240Hz refresh rate with a gorgeous quantum dot OLED panel. If you're looking for the best 4K gaming monitor , this should definitely be on your short list.

32" Alienware AW3225QF 4K OLED Monitor Hits an All-Time Low

32" Alienware AW3225QF 4K 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor

The Alienware AW3225QF is one of few Dell monitors that combines a 4K resolution with an OLED panel. This monitor incorporates Samsung's QD OLED technology; QD OLED panels are brighter than traditional OLED panels while maintaining near infinite response time, contrast ratio, and black levels that OLEDs are generally known for. The Alienware AW3225QF is HDR True Black 400 certified with up to 1,000 nits of peak brightness. It also boasts a factory calibrated 99.3% DCI-P3 color range, 1700R curve, 240Hz refresh rate , and G-Sync certification .

Connectivity-wise, the AW3225QF has two HDMI 2.1 ports (one with eARC) and one DisplayPort 1.4 port, all of which are capable of 4K at up to 240Hz. There are also a couple of USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports for attaching peripherals and a single USB Type-C port for charging. Dell backs this monitor up with a three-year warranty that includes burn-in protection .

Something to keep in mind is that 4K monitors require a pretty powerful GPU . 4K resolution has 2.25 times more pixels than QHD; if you want to play games in 4K, especially at frame rates of up to 240fps, you'll want a gaming PC equipped with an GeForce RTX 5070 at the minimum. If your PC is equipped with an even more powerful card like the RTX 5070 Ti , RTX 5080 , or RX 9070 XT , then this monitor would be the perfect complement.

articles.title: Rays Not Starting Drew Rasmussen In Game 1 of World Series
articles.summary: Game 1 of the World Series will take place Friday in Milwaukee
articles.body:
The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers will play Game 1 of the World Series on Friday, and it will be Jacob Misiorowski facing off against Nick Martinez.

The Rays are opting to start Nick Martinez, giving Drew Rasmussen and Freddy Peralta an extra day of rest. Rasmussen will be on five days of rest if he starts Game 2, and Peralta will be on six days of rest after making two starts and a relief outing in the American League Division Series.

Martinez has faced the Brewers once this season and gave up four hits, including one double and one home run. Of the Rays' top three starters, the Brewers' group of position players expected to be on the World Series roster have the most success against Martinez.

The Brewers' 13 position players have combined to go 30-for-122 with a .737 OPS against Martinez in his career. They also have six home runs and four walks.

Martinez had a 3.10 ERA in 31 starts this year after a down year with the Cincinnati Reds last year. He has made two postseason starts, posting a 3.00 ERA. Against the New York Yankees, he did not make it through four innings.

The Rays will be looking for him to be sharp against Misiorowski, but this move allows them to get Rasmussen and Peralta at their best. If Rasmussen pitches in Game 2, he will be lined up on five days of rest for Game 6. Assuming Peralta gets the ball in Game 3, he would be on four days of rest for what would be an all-hands-on-deck Game 7.
